demos.title: A join waits for both applications.
demos.question: Can the workflow finish before both required actions are complete?

source.quote: Initial Core hardening, including branching and joining, persisted states, current and next steps, and workflow-execution/back-office views.

steps.title: Choose the approval branch
steps.explanation: The decision enables financing and review. The alternative closure path is skipped.

steps.title: One approval is not enough
steps.explanation: Northbank has approved, but Alice’s review is pending. The join refuses to complete.

steps.title: Alice completes the review
steps.explanation: Both application actions are now recorded. The join becomes the next eligible step.

steps.title: The join completes
steps.explanation: The workflow completes only after its two required application actions.

demos.title: Two applications. One agreed workflow.
demos.question: Can participants agree a workflow, then execute the applications in order?

source.quote: Reference composition of two sample applications through the direct final-application-DAR interface implementation path.

steps.title: Alice accepts the plan
steps.explanation: Northbank proposed financing followed by review. Alice’s consent starts the workflow.

steps.title: Northbank approves financing
steps.explanation: The financing application advances through StepAction. Review is now the enabled step.

steps.title: Alice confirms the review
steps.explanation: The independent review application advances through the same interface. The workflow is complete.

demos.title: A private decision. A shared next step.
demos.question: Can Alice continue without seeing the bank’s private application?

source.quote: while preserving their separate ownership and execution rights.

steps.title: Alice cannot approve
steps.explanation: The application is visible only to Northbank. Alice’s attempted approval changes nothing.

steps.title: Northbank approves
steps.explanation: Northbank approves its application. Alice’s next step still waits for her own action.

steps.title: Alice continues
steps.explanation: Alice uses the scoped approval to complete her step. The bank’s private application stays private.

demos.title: Keep the application. Add an adapter.
demos.environment: Build tooling, then a separate 1-participant Canton run
demos.question: Can an existing application participate without changing its source?

source.quote: the boilerplate needed to bind the applicable application templates and their choices into the `harmonia-core` managed workflow model

steps.title: Compile the reviewed mapping
steps.explanation: Builder produces a typed adapter. The downloaded project preserves the original application DAR.

steps.title: The adapter grants no extra authority
steps.explanation: In the execution recording, Alice tries the action through the adapter. Only Northbank may approve.

steps.title: Northbank advances both contracts
steps.explanation: ExecuteAction calls the existing Approve choice. Application approval and workflow completion commit together.

demos.title: One settlement. Both sides or neither.
demos.environment: 4 participants · 1 local synchronizer · synthetic TEST units
demos.question: What remains on the ledger if the receiving application refuses?

source.quote: the final transfer path can collapse into one bounded atomic execution rather than remaining a staged sequence.

steps.title: The parties are ready
steps.explanation: Seller and buyer agree; both custodians are ready. Their preparation used separate transactions.

steps.title: Alice settles once
steps.explanation: Withdrawal, receipt and workflow completion appear in one observed settlement transaction.

steps.title: A second settlement is refused
steps.explanation: The destination still holds 10 TEST. Repeating the action creates no second transfer.

steps.title: Change the receiving rule
steps.explanation: A separate run starts with the same 10 TEST locked, but its receiving application will reject settlement.

steps.title: The whole settlement rolls back
steps.explanation: Receipt refuses. The 10 TEST remains locked at source; nothing arrives and the workflow stays waiting.
